missions.title: Third-Party Support Widget
missions.summary: Review a browser support feature that combines cross-window messaging, DOM rendering and a loaded client dependency.

targets.title: Support widget review route
targets.visibleBehavior: The prepared strong element is interpreted and rendered as markup.

targets.title: Support widget repaired route
targets.visibleBehavior: The same markup-shaped value is displayed literally as text.

missions.title: Deployment Response Boundary
missions.summary: Compare two visually identical deployments whose security difference exists only in browser-observed response metadata.

targets.title: Deployment response with metadata disclosure
targets.visibleBehavior: The page matches the repaired control, but inspecting its response reveals a technology disclosure header.

targets.title: Deployment response without metadata disclosure
targets.visibleBehavior: The same page and security baseline are returned without the technology disclosure header.

missions.title: Session-Bound Order Search
missions.summary: Capture and test a same-origin POST request that only exists after the browser establishes scoped session state.

targets.title: Order search review workflow
targets.visibleBehavior: A normal order search succeeds; the harmless prepared diagnostic exposes a database-query error.

request.setup: Open the review page to establish its scoped session and submit the search form.

targets.title: Order search repaired workflow
targets.visibleBehavior: The same normal and diagnostic searches complete without exposing a database-query error.

request.setup: Open the repaired page to establish its scoped session and submit the same search form.

missions.title: On-Demand Analytics
missions.summary: Observe a client dependency that does not exist in initial page traffic and appears only after a browser action opens an application feature.

targets.title: Analytics workspace review route
targets.visibleBehavior: The initial page is dependency-free; opening the workspace requests and runs the pinned review dependency.

targets.title: Analytics workspace repaired route
targets.visibleBehavior: The same action and analytics result are preserved while the browser loads the reviewed dependency version.

missions.title: Saved Workspace
missions.summary: Follow user-controlled browser state from a settings page into a separate same-origin dashboard document.

targets.title: Saved workspace review journey
targets.visibleBehavior: The settings page persists a harmless markup-shaped value; the child dashboard restores it as DOM markup.

journey.summary: Save the prepared announcement and follow the same-origin dashboard navigation.

targets.title: Saved workspace repaired journey
targets.visibleBehavior: The same state and navigation are preserved while the child dashboard restores the value as literal text.

journey.summary: Save the same prepared announcement and follow the same-origin dashboard navigation.

missions.title: Live Profile Preview
missions.summary: Follow a same-origin JSON response field into a DOM rendering path that exists only after a browser action.

targets.title: Live profile review target
targets.visibleBehavior: The initial page has no profile traffic; the action loads a JSON field and interprets its harmless markup in the preview.

action.summary: Press Open live profile preview and wait for the response status.

targets.title: Live profile repaired control
targets.visibleBehavior: The same action and JSON response are preserved while its markup-shaped field is displayed as literal text.

action.summary: Press the same preview button and wait for the response status.

missions.title: Transient Route Notice
missions.summary: Observe a short-lived SPA deep-link value that reaches the DOM after an in-document hash-route change.

targets.title: Transient route notice review target
targets.visibleBehavior: The action changes only the fragment route; its harmless notice becomes markup for 30 ms before expiring.

action.summary: Press Open prepared route notice and scan the resulting hash-query route.

targets.title: Transient route notice repaired control
targets.visibleBehavior: The same known route value maps to constant text for 30 ms; unknown values are rejected without reflection.

action.summary: Press the same button and scan the resulting hash-query route.

missions.title: Imported Request Preferences
missions.summary: Trace a user-imported client configuration into an inherited browser request option, then compare an own-property allow-list repair.

targets.title: Imported preferences review target
targets.visibleBehavior: The imported document leaves the request object with no own credentials key, but its inherited value changes the same-origin preview request.

action.summary: Press Import and load preview, then inspect the request-options evidence.

targets.title: Imported preferences repaired control
targets.visibleBehavior: The same input and preview request use a null-prototype object containing only an accepted own credentials option.

action.summary: Press the same import button and inspect the repaired request-options evidence.

missions.title: History Order Router
missions.summary: Follow an in-document History API transition into a browser-created authenticated JSON request.

targets.title: History order router review target
targets.visibleBehavior: The document stays loaded while route-controlled markup is interpreted and a browser-session JSON request is emitted.

request.setup: Open the review page to establish its scoped session, then press Open prepared order.

action.summary: Press Open prepared order and observe the route, DOM and JSON request.

targets.title: History order router repaired control
targets.visibleBehavior: The same route and request use an allow-listed identifier, constant text, and a clean API response.

request.setup: Open the repaired page to establish its scoped session, then press Open prepared order.

action.summary: Press the same order action and observe the reviewed route and JSON request.

missions.title: Lazy Analytics Route
missions.summary: Reveal an SPA route module and dependency that do not exist in browser traffic before the user action.

targets.title: Lazy analytics route review target
targets.visibleBehavior: The route action imports a new module, loads jQuery 3.4.1, and interprets the prepared route summary as markup.

action.summary: Observe initial traffic, then press Open analytics route.

targets.title: Lazy analytics route repaired control
targets.visibleBehavior: The same lazy route loads jQuery 3.7.1 and renders an allow-listed summary as text.

action.summary: Observe initial traffic, then press the same analytics action.

missions.title: Related Child Tab
missions.summary: Continue analysis in a causally related same-origin tab while preserving an explicit different-origin scope boundary.

targets.title: Related child-tab review journey
targets.visibleBehavior: The related child loads jQuery 3.4.1, accepts the workspace message as HTML, and receives a response metadata disclosure locally.

journey.summary: Open the prepared child and inspect evidence in the new same-origin tab.

targets.title: Related child-tab repaired journey
targets.visibleBehavior: The related child validates its opener, loads jQuery 3.7.1, renders text, and receives a clean local response.

journey.summary: Open the paired child and inspect evidence in the new same-origin tab.
